description: Fictitious claim fraud, rare binary (~2% positive rate).
sizingNote: 30,000 rows at a 2% rate gives about 600 positives (Ruling Q9 asks for >= 500; realized 626), so thresholded precision/recall and calibration rest on hundreds of events. The binomial SE of the rate is 0.00083, so the planned 0.02 sits about 6 SE from each edge of the [0.015, 0.025] check.
interceptCalibration: node probes/scenarios/calibrate_intercept.mjs probes/scenarios/specs/C2.json: Loom calibrateIntercept over 200,000 feature draws (stream C2:calibration) solving mean(sigmoid(b0 + betas.x)) = 0.02; output in evidence/logs/P2/C2-calibration.txt
